description: This file defines a custom WPF/UWP control class 'OperatorPanelButton' that extends ToggleButton, with dependency properties for Text, Glyph, font sizes, and a Flyout menu, including event handling for template application and toggle behavior.

classes.name: OperatorPanelButton
classes.description: A custom toggle button control with additional properties for text, glyph, font sizes, and a flyout menu, used within the CalculatorApp controls namespace.

methods.name: OnApplyTemplate
methods.description: Overrides the method to attach event handlers when the control template is applied.

methods.name: OnToggle
methods.description: Overrides toggle behavior to show the flyout menu when checked.

methods.name: FlyoutClosed
methods.description: Event handler to reset the IsChecked state when the flyout closes.
